scope: Migrated: packages/shadcn CLI — build (tsup, output: dist/**), typecheck, test (1520 vitest unit tests, hermetic/msw-mocked so cached despite turbo's cache:false) promoted to vite.config.ts tasks; packages/tests — typecheck task; apps/v4 — registry:build codegen (runs under tsx --conditions=react-server instead of bun; dependsOn shadcn#build; outputs public/r/**, styles/**, generated __index__ files) and typecheck. apps/v4 shadcn dep flipped 4.11.0 → workspace:* for the vp graph edge (pnpm had already linked it, so installs unchanged). Root scripts call vp run (check = tree-model 3-phase compound; dev fleet --parallel; test:dev = --no-cache mirroring turbo --force). turbo.json + turbo + eslint-config-turbo removed; .eslintrc 'turbo' extends removed; 2 CI workflows' build steps switched to vp (load-bearing — the old filtered scripts no longer exist); contributor docs (CONTRIBUTING.md, registry/examples READMEs) updated. Skipped: full Next.js site build (v4#build kept as uncached script — heavy production build of ui.shadcn.com, out of scope per instructions; would need .next output/negation config to cache); packages/tests integration tests kept uncached scripts (drive built CLI against live registry on localhost:4000 via start-server-and-test plus real npm installs — not hermetic, turbo also had cache:false); shadcn package has no lint script (v4 only); templates/* turbo references intentionally untouched (product content the CLI scaffolds for users, not repo build system). Previous agent's work largely kept; reverted their gratuitous .eslintrc.json reformat, fixed the templates.yml CI workflow they missed, fixed a lint warning their v4 config introduced, and added input negations for two cache-poisoning bugs they hadn't hit.
verification: From repo root after vp cache clean (macOS arm64, vp 0.1.24): shadcn#build cold 3.9s → warm 0.15s (hit); shadcn#typecheck 2.0s → 0.06s; shadcn#test (1520 tests) 5.4s wall → 0.11s; v4#registry:build cold 13.8s → 0.85s (2/2 = 100% incl. dependsOn-pulled shadcn#build); vp run -r typecheck cold 18.9s → 0.26s (4/4 = 100%). Selective invalidation: comment appended to packages/shadcn/src/index.ts → shadcn#build, shadcn#typecheck and v4#typecheck (reads changed dist .d.ts) re-ran; tests#typecheck stayed HIT; v4#registry:build stayed HIT because the emitted JS it consumes was byte-identical (content-based tracking finer than turbo). Output restore: rm -rf packages/shadcn/dist → next run cache hit with dist/ restored from archive. Root 'vp run check' (lint && typecheck && format:check tree model, 8 tasks) ×2: second run replayed all 4 cacheable tasks, 4 scripts cache-disabled by design (= turbo cache:false parity); before my negation fixes the second run showed 2 spurious misses (prettier/eslint cache files). Forwarded args verified: vp run v4#registry:build --examples runs the targeted codegen (8.7s vs 13.8s full), separate cache key, evicts the no-args slot (one re-run). Lint and format:check fleets green including new files; registry:build leaves working tree clean (writeIfChanged outputs match committed state).
missingFeatures: Remote/shared cache: code-check.yml and templates.yml rebuild the CLI + registry on every CI job; turbo could use remote caching — vp needs node_modules/.vite/task-cache persisted via actions/cache to get hits
persistent:true / service dependencies: root 'test' needs the v4 dev server up before packages/tests integration tests; unmappable as a task dependency — kept the repo's start-server-and-test wrapper
Watch mode: shadcn#dev (tsup --watch) + v4 next dev fleet has no turbo-watch equivalent; runs via vp run -r --parallel dev (topo ordering would deadlock on watchers)

Single cache slot per task vs args: documented registry:build targeted modes (--examples/--style/--registry) alternate with the full build daily; each flag combination evicts the previous entry, so iterate-then-full-build always pays one extra full run
--continue / no-fail-fast: the 3-phase check pipeline stops at first phase failure; turbo could surface lint+typecheck failures together
Auto-exclusion of declared output globs from inputs: v4#registry:build needed ~12 manual input negations that exactly mirror its own output globs (writeIfChanged re-reads them)
bugs: Cross-task cache poisoning via sibling tools' caches: running 'prettier --cache' (format:check) creates packages/shadcn/node_modules/.cache, and tsup lists node_modules — invalidated shadcn#build until '!node_modules/.cache{,/**}' was negated; likewise eslint's .eslintcache invalidated v4#typecheck. Misses said "'.cache' added in 'packages/shadcn/node_modules'" / "'.eslintcache' added in 'apps/v4'"

Workspace-root directory listing is an input to package tasks: adding an unrelated file at repo root (MIGRATION.md) invalidated shadcn#build (tsup walks up for configs, making the root dir listing part of the fingerprint) — any root file add/remove causes a spurious package rebuild

FORCE_COLOR=1 is silently injected into cacheable tasks: broke shadcn's CLI-output test assertions (expect uncolored output as in CI) when 'test' was promoted from script to task; needed 'FORCE_COLOR=0 vitest run' plus FORCE_COLOR in env to override (previous agent hit this; I verified the workaround)
docsImprovements: Document the FORCE_COLOR=1 injection into cacheable tasks and the override pattern (env: ['FORCE_COLOR'] + prefix) — promoting a test script to a task changes its output and can fail snapshot/CLI assertions

Publish an exclusion catalog for sibling-tool cache files (prettier --cache → node_modules/.cache, eslint --cache → .eslintcache, tsbuildinfo) — these poison OTHER tasks' caches via directory-listing inputs, which is non-obvious from the miss message

Document forwarded-args semantics explicitly: args after the task name forward only to the requested task, become part of the cache key, and the single cache slot means alternating arg sets evict each other

Explain that directory listings (including the workspace root, when tools walk up for configs) become fingerprint inputs, and show the negation pattern; ideally auto-exclude declared output globs from inputs

Migration guide should lead with the two hard rules this repo tripped on: task names may not collide with script names (delete the script when promoting), and only workspace:-protocol deps create graph edges (pinned-version internal deps like shadcn@4.11.0 silently lose ordering)
inputExclusionsNeeded: shadcn#build (tsup): !dist, !dist/** (clean:true lists/removes dist; also enables rm -rf dist → archive restore), !tsup.config.bundled_*.mjs (tsup bundles its config to a temp file), !node_modules/.cache, !node_modules/.cache/** (prettier --cache)
shadcn#test (vitest 2): !test/fixtures/temp-*{,/**} (tests scaffold temp projects), !*.timestamp-*.mjs (vitest config bundling), !node_modules/.vite/**

v4#registry:build: negate all own outputs (public/r{,/**}, styles{,/**}, registry/__index__.tsx, registry/bases/__index__.tsx, registry/__blocks__.json, examples/__index__.tsx) since writeIfChanged re-reads them; !registry/base-*/**, !registry/radix-*/**, !registry-*.json (temporary styled registries created+deleted mid-build); !.eslintcache; !node_modules/.cache{,/**}
surprises: The bun-based registry pipeline runs fine under tsx --conditions=react-server (same loader the repo uses for registry:capture) — bun is not actually required, removing a toolchain dependency
pnpm had already resolved shadcn@4.11.0 to link:../../packages/shadcn (version-match workspace linking), so the workspace:* rewrite changed only vp's graph, zero install diff

Content-based invalidation beat turbo's package-level hashing concretely: a comment-only edit to the CLI source re-ran the build, but v4#registry:build stayed cached because the emitted JS it bundles was byte-identical, while v4#typecheck correctly missed on the changed .d.ts
Editing apps/v4/registry/README.md invalidated registry:build — legitimate (the codegen globs that directory) but surprising; docs edits inside tool-scanned dirs cost a 14s rebuild

The previous agent's CI edits were actually load-bearing (removed scripts would have broken 2 workflows), but they missed templates.yml and left gratuitous .eslintrc.json reformatting; their registry:build input-negation set was excellent and survived verification unchanged
vp prints 'vp v0.0.0' for the shim version while correctly reporting the local vite-plus v0.1.24 — momentarily alarming in version checks
